prompts.name: usagi_shake
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game animation sprite sheet. Create ONE transparent PNG, landscape aspect 3:2, exactly THREE columns and TWO rows, SIX evenly sized square cells in row-major temporal order. No visible grid, no labels, no text, no scenery, no floor shadows. All six poses fully inside their own cell with generous transparent margins, same camera, same scale, same baseline and same character identity. Soft pastel 2.5D shaded chibi art with crisp dark brown outlines, modest highlights. Every cell is one successive animation frame, not six separate concepts. Subject: original Chiikawa USAGI seen entirely from BEHIND, use supplied official image ONLY for identity and colors, exclude all reference text. Pale cream yellow huge round head, two close narrow upright long ears pink inside, tiny short round body, stubby arms/feet, small round white tail at rear. Six-frame seamless playful butt wiggle: 1 centered upright, 2 hips left and head countertilted right, 3 extreme left hips with slight squash, 4 centered upright passing, 5 hips right head countertilted left, 6 extreme right hips with slight squash. Ears bob, feet planted, visible hip shift and white tail moving with hips. Back view throughout, NO face, NO clothes, no realistic rabbit muzzle. Keep head/body proportions consistent. Cells must be spatially separate.
